card.name: Final 'and'/'or' closing a list
card.fires_on: The word 'and' or 'or' right after the last comma in a list of items, such as drugs, risks or symptoms. It also fires on a few word-ending pieces, such as 'acid' in a chemical name.

modes.label: List-ending and/or
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' placed after a comma or semicolon just before the last item in a list.
modes.example: limited information regarding dose, duration, and timing of drug exposure;<< and>> concomitant use of other medications.

modes.label: Word-ending pieces
modes.description: The last piece of a longer name, such as a chemical or group name.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the little word 'and' or 'or' that comes just before the last item in a list.
